# zerotier_v2_network (Resource)

A Central V2 network, created inside a network group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerotier_v2_network" "lab" {
  network_group_id = zerotier_v2_network_group.lab.id
  name             = "lab"

  v4_subnet           = "10.99.0.0/24"
  v4_assignment_pools = [{ start = "10.99.0.10", end = "10.99.0.250" }]
  routes              = [{ target = "192.168.50.0/24", via = "10.99.0.1" }]

  dns_domain  = "lab.example.com"
  dns_servers = ["10.99.0.53"]

  mtu             = 2800
  multicast_limit = 32
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the network.
- `network_group_id` (String) ID of the network group the network belongs to. Changing it creates a new network.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the network.
- `dns_domain` (String) DNS search domain pushed to members. Required when `dns_servers` is set.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) DNS server addresses pushed to members (up to 10).
- `enable_broadcast` (Boolean) Allow Ethernet broadcast (ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff).
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the virtual network adapter on members.
- `multicast_limit` (Number) Maximum recipients of a multicast or broadcast packet. Must be 0 when `enable_broadcast` is false.
- `private` (Boolean) Whether members must be authorized to join. If false, any device can join.
- `routes` (List of Object) Additional routes (`{ target, via }`) pushed to members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `v4_assignment_pools` (List of Object) IPv4 ranges (`{ start, end }`) addresses are auto-assigned from. Must fall inside `v4_subnet`. Central picks one when unset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--v4_assignment_pools))
- `v4_auto_assign` (Boolean) Auto-assign IPv4 addresses from `v4_assignment_pools`.
- `v4_subnet` (String) IPv4 subnet (CIDR) of the network. Central picks a random one when unset; set `v4_assignment_pools` with it.
- `v6_assign_6plane` (Boolean) Assign each member a 6PLANE /80.
- `v6_assign_rfc4193` (Boolean) Assign each member an RFC 4193 /128.
- `v6_assignment_pools` (List of Object) IPv6 ranges (`{ start, end }`) addresses are auto-assigned from. Must fall inside `v6_subnet`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--v6_assignment_pools))
- `v6_auto_assign` (Boolean) Auto-assign IPv6 addresses from `v6_assignment_pools`.
- `v6_subnet` (String) IPv6 subnet (canonical CIDR) of the network.

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) When the network was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Network ID.
- `kind` (String) Kind of network. `v1` is a ZeroTier One network.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import zerotier_v2_network.lab 8056c2e21c1930be
```
